onboarding.slide3_desc: Order today before 23:00 — we shop at 05:00 at sunrise and deliver straight to your door before lunch.

common.footer_rights: FreshMarket • Fresh market produce at your doorstep
common.gallery_subtitle: Real produce hand-picked from growers and fishing boats this morning

journal.hero_title: We head out at dawn so you have fresh market produce on your breakfast table.
journal.hero_subtitle: No warehouses or stale cooler shelves. A personal shopper selects ripe fruits, morning boat catch, and herbs from trusted vendors right before delivery to your doorstep.
journal.story_title: A Buyer's Morning: From Dawn Boats to Your Table
journal.step1_desc: Your buyer arrives as vendors unload night catch crates and fresh morning bunches.
journal.step2_desc: Every single item is hand-inspected for ripeness and freshness, noting the exact gram scale weight.
journal.step3_desc: Couriers arrive in chilled totes with the physical merchant paper bill pinned to your bag.
journal.ledger_desc: Zero hidden markups: pay the actual merchant receipt price + a transparent personal shopping fee.
journal.zone3_desc: Outlying private retreats and countryside villas (~09:30–10:15)

stalls.hero_title: Morning Market Stalls at Your Door
stalls.hero_subtitle: Four core open-air aisles: fresh boat catch, crunchy farm produce, orchard fruits, and aromatic roots.
stalls.stall1_desc: Wild sea fish, prawns, and squid brought directly from dawn boats.
stalls.stall2_desc: Thai eggplants, crisp cucumbers, winged beans, and leafy greens.
stalls.stall3_desc: Mangoes, green tamarind, fresh banana flowers, rambutan, and dragonfruit.
stalls.stall4_desc: Fresh ginger root, fragrant lemongrass stalks, white daikon, and Asian basil.
stalls.rule1_desc: Pick your groceries in the catalog before night or by 06:00 AM.
stalls.rule2_desc: Your buyer purchases produce at true open-air market prices.
stalls.rule3_desc: Courier brings your order by 08:30–09:30 with the merchant paper bill.

silk.hero_title: Fresh Market Produce. Straight to Your Door.
silk.hero_subtitle: Select items in the catalog the night before. At dawn, a buyer hand-picks the best produce from vendors, and couriers deliver it in time for breakfast.
silk.block1_desc: No warehouses or long cold storage. All produce is purchased directly at the open-air market on the day of delivery at opening.
silk.block2_desc: Pay the exact handwritten receipt from the market seller + a 10% personal shopping fee with zero inflated retail margins.
silk.block3_desc: Couriers deliver chilled totes straight to your table or veranda. Settle with cash or QR code after inspecting your order.
